newsitem.title: UK: LME copper recovers slightly in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper recovers slightly in late trading.

text.p: LME copper recovered some lost ground in late inter-office trading on Monday after a volatile day which saw three months prices tumble in the wake of a sharp technical squeeze.
Prices managed to hold just above the $2,350 level, but traders said the technical action and weak close suggested that the downside would be tested again.
At 1800 GMT copper was indicated at $2,367/69 after the kerb close of $2,356, down $27 from Friday's close.
The cash/threes backwardation, which stood at $210 at one stage, stood at $90/100 after a close of $87/97.
Aluminium edged higher and was indicated at $1,634/36 after a constructive day against a background of technical tightness in early July.
Nickel weakened to $7,425/50 after closing $20 easier at $7,460. Other metals were little changed.
